fields.value: What does Backups cover?

faqChildren.name: How is this different from snapshots

fields.name: Question
fields.value: How is this different from snapshots?

fields.name: Answer
fields.value: Snapshots are point-in-time manual copies; Backups provide scheduled automated protection.

faqChildren.name: Can I restore to a new instance

fields.name: Question
fields.value: Can I restore to a new instance?

fields.name: Answer
fields.value: Yes — restore workflows let you recover to a replacement instance.
